narrative: OMX30 faces a negative open Monday as European bourses capitulate on broad risk-off sentiment (DAX -1.26%, CAC -1.49%) despite a bull market regime backdrop (+3.2% vs 200-MA). The weighted correlation signal of -1.008% and NASDAQ's -2.15% plunge signal renewed growth concerns that override commodity support (copper +0.99%, gold +0.30%). Weak ADX (11.8) with bearish DI bias and RSI at neutral 45 strip conviction; the index sits 2.6% from highs in lower-half Bollinger territory. USD/SEK weakness (-0.58%) neutralizes export gains, while geopolitical headlines (French riots, Iran nuclear posturing) keep risk sentiment fragile. Watch for mean reversion if VIX holds above 18.
morningBrief: OMX30 likely opens -0.3% to -0.7% tracking European weakness and NASDAQ contagion. Industrials and Banks face crosswinds: Volvo/Atlas Copco hurt by USD/SEK weakness despite oil decline; SEB/Handelsbanken supported marginally by 10Y yield +18bp but risk-off sentiment dominates. Boliden gets lift from copper +0.99% and gold +0.30%, but size (3.3% of index) limits macro impact. Tech (Ericsson, Hexagon) pressured by NASDAQ -2.15% and risk-off rotation into defensives (AstraZeneca, Essity). Key support 3085 (lower Bollinger); resistance 3180 (50-MA). ADX weakness means low conviction—range trade likely until macro clarity. Watch US Jobless Claims (14:30 CET) and geopolitical headlines; VIX at 18.6 still elevated.
